t: A free course that teaches TinyML on the Wio Terminal board.
steps: Find the Wio Terminal TinyML course on the Seeed Studio wiki.
Buy a Wio Terminal and confirm the price.
Ask IT to install the Arduino IDE.
Download the course PDF and the GitHub repository.
Create an Edge Impulse account for a teacher first.
Run the first project with the sensors.
Check what data Edge Impulse stores before students sign in.
